hero.badge: Ma nguon mo · Tu luu tru · Mien phi
hero.title:
Kham pha moi bai hat
voi do chinh xac cua AI
hero.description: Tai len cac tep am thanh cua ban. StemTube tach stem, nhan dien hop am, dong bo loi bai hat va cung cap cho ban mot bo mixer hoan chinh — san sang de luyen tap, hoc hoi hoac sang tao.
features.label: Tinh nang
features.title: StemTube co the lam gi
features.subtitle: Cac tinh nang phan tich am thanh cot loi chay cuc bo tren may cua ban. Mot so tinh nang van dang thu nghiem — phan hoi cua ban se dinh huong lo trinh phat trien.
feature.stems.title: Tach stem bang AI
feature.stems.desc: Tach bat ky bai hat nao thanh giong hat, bass, trong, guitar, piano va nhieu hon nua bang Demucs. Chon giua mo hinh 4 stem va 6 stem tuy theo muc do chi tiet ban can.
feature.chords.title: Nhan dien hop am
feature.chords.desc: Pipeline ket hop BTC Transformer + madmom CRF nhan dien 170 loai hop am. Hien thi hop am theo thoi gian thuc voi bieu do guitar dong bo voi phat lai.
feature.lyrics.title: Loi bai hat dong bo
feature.lyrics.desc: Loi bai hat dong bo tu Musixmatch voi phuong an du phong la phien am Whisper AI. Danh dau thoi gian tung tu voi kieu noi bat karaoke va che do Tap trung rieng.
feature.mixer.title: Mixer day du
feature.mixer.desc: Dieu chinh am luong, pan, tat tieng va solo cho tung stem. Dieu chinh nhip do voi chinh sua cao do qua SoundTouch. Hien thi dang song voi thanh truot phat lai.
feature.recording.title: Phong thu am Thu nghiem
feature.recording.desc: Thu am nhac cu hoac giong hat cua ban tren cac stem voi bu do tre va khu nhieu bang Demucs. Tinh nang nay van dang phat trien — hoan nghenh phan hoi va dong gop.
feature.jam.title: Phien jam Thu nghiem
feature.jam.desc: Phong jam cong tac qua WebSocket voi BPM chung va phat lai dong bo. Truy cap khach voi ten tu dong, khong can tai khoan. Van dang trong qua trinh phat trien.
feature.mobile.title: PWA di dong
feature.mobile.desc: Ung dung web luy tien cho iOS va Android. Mixer toi uu cho cam ung, thu am, hien thi hop am va loi bai hat — cung cac tinh nang cot loi nhu phien ban desktop.
feature.themes.title: Giao dien
feature.themes.desc: Nhieu giao dien truc quan bao gom che do neumorphic va cyberpunk. Thiet ke khong phai la diem manh cua chung toi — neu ban co ky nang UI/UX, chung toi rat mong nhan duoc su giup do cua ban.
feature.selfhosted.title: Tu luu tru
feature.selfhosted.desc: Chay tren phan cung cua ban. Tang toc GPU voi tu dong nhan dien CUDA, tu dong chuyen sang CPU khi can. Du lieu cua ban o tren may cua ban.
howItWorks.label: Cach hoat dong
howItWorks.title: Tu tep am thanh den mixer hoan chinh chi trong vai phut
step1.title: Tai len tep
step1.desc: Keo tha bat ky tep MP3, WAV, FLAC hoac dinh dang am thanh nao khac. StemTube kiem tra cac trich xuat da co de tranh xu ly trung lap.
step2.title: Phan tich AI
step2.desc: Demucs tach stem. BTC + madmom nhan dien hop am. Musixmatch hoac Whisper lay loi bai hat. Tat ca chay song song.
step3.title: Mix va luyen tap
step3.desc: Mo mixer day du. Tat tieng guitar va choi theo voi hop am hien thi theo thoi gian thuc. Dieu chinh nhip do ma khong thay doi cao do.
step4.title: Thu am va jam
step4.desc: Thu am phan trinh dien cua ban tren cac stem. Moi ban be vao phong jam. Chia se phat lai dong bo theo thoi gian thuc.
screenshots.label: Anh chup man hinh
screenshots.title: Xem hoat dong thuc te
screenshots.subtitle: Giao dien desktop, thiet ke danh cho nhac si.

screenshot4.caption: Phien jam — Chia se qua ma QR, WhatsApp, email hoac lien ket truc tiep
tech.label: Cong nghe su dung
tech.title: Xay dung voi cac cong cu ma nguon mo da duoc chung minh
contribute.label: Dong gop
contribute.title: Du an nay can ban
contribute.motto: Mot minh toi di nhanh, cung nhau chung ta se di xa hon.
contribute.desc: StemTube duoc cung cap nhu mot giai phap hoan chinh. Tuy nhien, cac cam ket nghe nghiep va ca nhan khong cho phep toi dua no di xa hon mot minh. Day la luc ban xuat hien:
contribute.item1: Thiet ke UI/UX — giao dien hien tai hoat dong tot nhung toi gian. Neu ban co ky nang thiet ke, dong gop cua ban se tao nen su khac biet thuc su.
contribute.item2: Phat trien Frontend — giup cai thien trai nghiem di dong, lam dep mixer va cac tuong tac.
contribute.item3: Kiem thu va bao loi — thu tren cac phan cung va trinh duyet khac nhau, bao cao loi, de xuat cai tien.
contribute.item4: Ban dich — giup StemTube co the truy cap duoc bang nhieu ngon ngu hon.
story.label: Gioi thieu
story.title: Mot thi nghiem vibe coding tro thanh du an ma nguon mo
story.p1: StemTube bat dau nhu mot thi nghiem ve vibe coding — kham pha dieu gi xay ra khi ban de qua trinh phat trien ho tro boi AI dan dat qua trinh sang tao ma khong co ke hoach cung nhac.
story.p2: Nhung gi bat dau nhu mot du an cuoi tuan da tro thanh mot tram lam viec am nhac dang phat trien. Du an tiep tuc phat trien vi cac van de thuc su thu vi de giai quyet: lam sao dong bo nhan dien hop am voi thanh truot dang song? Lam sao bu do tre thu am tren cac trinh duyet khac nhau?
story.quote: Sau 25 nam trong nganh CNTT, toi muon tra lai cho he sinh thai ma nguon mo da cho toi rat nhieu trong suot su nghiep. StemTube la dong gop do — khong hoan hao, dang phat trien va mo cho tat ca.
story.p3: Toan bo ma nguon la mo, tu pipeline AI den frontend PWA. Khong theo doi, khong yeu cau tai khoan cho su dung co ban, khong phu thuoc dam may. Am nhac cua ban, may cua ban.
cta.title: Ban muon thu?
cta.desc: Clone repo, chay script cai dat va ban se san sang trong vai phut. Hoan nghenh phan hoi va dong gop.
disclaimer.title: Su dung co trach nhiem
disclaimer.text: StemTube la cong cu de hoc, luyen tap va sang tao am nhac. No khong nham muc dich ho tro vi pham ban quyen hay xam hai quyen loi cua nghe si. Moi nguoi dung tu chiu trach nhiem ve viec su dung phan mem nay theo luat phap cua quoc gia ho. Xin hay ton trong cac nghe si ma ban yeu thich am nhac cua ho.
